scope: Standard free public GitHub Windows 2022/2025 VMs. Actual public EXE and MCP/Windows/Edge operations. Membership boundary tests use an isolated protocol simulator, not real customer accounts or live payment. In-app upgrade test installs actual 0.14 then bootstraps 0.16.2 and lowers only its package version on the disposable VM to exercise the real current updater against the real public package.

reports.updaterScenario: Only the installed package version is lowered on this disposable VM; all updater code and real production downloads are unchanged
checks: real 0.14 to new bootstrap installation preserves default encrypted device identity and user data
17 updater integrity, range, cancellation and version-order tests pass against the installed code on this Windows VM
customer interface hides technical fields, keeps permissions accessible and fits the desktop window
actual packaged UI checks newer release, downloads over HTTPS, reports progress and verifies the real installer
cancel in the native installation confirmation leaves current program and verified download available
verified installer runs after the old process exits and installs the expected version in the same directory
new version automatically opens a real desktop window after installation
successful upgrade removes its cached installer without deleting user data
upgraded program opens with the same encrypted identity, preferences and workspace files
